messages:
rachel_csm: Heads up — Meridian EBR Tue 4/8 11am PT. Need final slide deck by EOD Mon. TL;DR: account health, onboarding status, renewal risks, enablement asks. Who can own which slides?

maria_cs_ops: I can do account health + renewal risk slide. Will pull latest NPS, MAU, and usage cohort charts.

sam_eng: I'll take onboarding status + migration blockers. Will include open JIRAs and ETA for fixes. @alex_design can you help with two screenshots (ingest flow + dashboard)?

alex_design: yep can do — send exact routes/screens you want. I can have assets by today 6pm.

alyssa_pm: I'll own enablement/feedback capture slide. Would like a single slide for outstanding enablement asks + owners. Also add 1 bullet for feedback themes.

ben_sales: I'll draft the exec summary (1 slide) with renewal recommendation and ask. Dropping draft here: https://drive.redwood/reports/meridian-ebr-draft (please add comments directly).

rachel_csm: Nice — I'll consolidate and finalize slide order. Quick checklist:

```
1) Cover + Exec summary (ben_sales)
2) Account health metrics (maria_cs_ops)
3) Onboarding status + open issues (sam_eng)
4) Adoption & success stories (rachel_csm)
5) Enablement asks & feedback themes (alyssa_pm)
6) Renewal risk + recommended next steps (maria_cs_ops + ben_sales)
7) Appendix: logs / PS notes / timelines (sam_eng)
```

maria_cs_ops: I'll add owners into the deck comments and leave TODOs for data refresh by 6pm PT.

sam_eng: One blocking callout to include — API quota spike last month that affected ingestion. I'll add a slide note and a proposed throttle/backfill plan.

rachel_csm: Can we do a 30-min dry run Mon 5:00pm PT? @everyone please confirm availability. If not, we record and circulate.

alex_design: 5:00pm works for me.

ben_sales: works for me.

alyssa_pm: small conflict at 5:00 — can we do 4:30? if not I can prerecord my 2-min notes for the enablement slide.

rachel_csm: Ok tentatively 5pm — if Alyssa can't make it, we'll play her recording. Ben/@maria_cs_ops can you surface the renewal risk one-pager to include in exec readout?

maria_cs_ops: Uploading snapshot now: https://drive.redwood/meridian/renewal-snapshot-v1 — includes churn signals + exec asks.

ebot: Reminder set — Slide deck deadline: 2024-04-07 23:59 PDT. Owner: rachel_csm.

rachel_csm: Great. I'll compile everything and ping when the deck is ready for review (aiming by 7pm PT). Please use comments for edits, and flag any data gaps. :thumbsup:

ben_sales: Noted. I'll add talking points under the exec summary slide.

sam_eng: I'll post the list of JIRAs and ETA in the deck comments once I finish.

alex_design: I'll drop PNGs into the assets folder and update the slide placeholders.

alyssa_pm: I'll prerecord my 2-min narration if needed and share a link by EOD.

rachel_csm: Thanks team — much appreciated. We'll run the dry rehearsal Mon 5:00pm PT unless someone loudly objects before EOD.

(reacts) rachel_csm: :thumbsup:
